performance.schedulerObservation: The integrated hidden browser refreshed at approximately 30 Hz; this is not represented as a full-viewer >=30 FPS pass.

knownLimits: Public deployment/postflight is outside this LOCAL validation snapshot.
The full integrated in-app browser rAF observation was 29.79 FPS, not a strict >=30 FPS proof; the 456.27 FPS value measures main-thread submit in the real Chromium/WebGL2 vegetation harness.
Grass005 official metadata does not publish a non-zero physical tile size, so its 8x8 repeat is an empirical visual choice.
The retained Island Tree 02 scores only 6/10 for suburban style match, but passed the 8/10 realism target and beat the winter candidate after A/B.
The bed scores 4/10 for texture richness; local visual QA accepted its overall realism/proportions, but it remains the weakest close-up material in the pilot.
Kitchen, bathroom, roof, floor, indoor plants and HDRI were not part of the mandatory eight-category pilot and are not claimed as integrated external assets.
